description: Start the OAuth flow for a Mastodon account. Pass the user's server, handle or profile URL; Chirpie keeps only the server. A value naming no server is refused with mastodon_instance_invalid.

instance_url.description: The Mastodon server, in any form: "mastodon.social", "https://mastodon.social/", a handle ("@you@mastodon.social") or a profile URL ("https://mastodon.social/@you").

name: chirpie_connect_mastodon
title: Connect a Mastodon account
